claims.statement: April 15 withdrawal votes were twice inconclusive: 141 present, 46 yes 58 no; then 44 yes 68 no. Chair declared withdrawal request abandoned.
June 3 cabinet return of property freeze bill was publicly justified by revenue and asset deterioration concerns.
June 15 interim property law repassage is reported as 144 present, 132 yes, 10 no; original stenogram remains target.
December 3 property disposal reconsideration had 135 present, 20 yes and 49 no; original was not reaffirmed by two thirds.
November 16 debate proposed cooperative worker priority, but final Act 74 prioritized employees without explicitly giving cooperative priority.
Act 74 required review by management committee before minister selected property buyers.
